items.title: Cabinet approves continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme for five years from 2026-27 to 2030-31

items.title: Ministry of Cooperation mandates new Audit Reporting Framework for Multi-State Cooperative Societies to strengthen transparency, accountability and good governance

items.summary: IDBI Bank Ltd. is a scheduled commercial bank regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Due to its poor financial health, the Bank required repeated infusion of capital, initially provided by the Government of India and later by the LIC. items.title: Government Approves Strategic Restructuring of IDBI Bank Ltd.

items.title: India’s Coir Sector: Creating Livelihoods, Promoting Entrepreneurship and Driving Sustainable Growth

items.title: Central Government approves India’s accession to Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA)

items.summary: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has approved payment of PLB of 78 days for Rs.2009.61 crore to 11,40,770 railway employees, in recognition of the excellent performance by the Railway staff.
items.title: Cabinet approves Productivity Linked Bonus (PLB) for 78 days to Railway Employees

items.summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has once again unearthed a large-scale scheme to circumvent India’s prohibition on the import of goods originating in or exported from Pakistan. Under “Operation Deep Manifest”.
items.title: DRI busts illegal import of more than 73,00,000 kg of Pakistan-origin rock salt; four arrested
